Great, template matches. Now we need to return mapped_rxn and template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash). The template_id is likely the integer ID? In the search result, each entry has 'reaction_id' and 'template_hash'. The template_id we used is probably the reaction_id? The tool check expects template_id string; we passed '1914385' which is reaction_id. So template_id = 1914385.

We need mapped_rxn associated with the template. In the search result entry, there is 'mapped_rxn' field. For reaction_id 1914385, mapped_rxn is:

'[CH2:6]=[CH:7][CH:8]=[CH2:9].[CH3:1][O:2][C:3](=[O:4])[C:5]1=[CH:10][C:11](=[O:12])[CH2:13]1>>[CH3:1][O:2][C:3](=[O:4])[C@:5]12[CH2:6][CH:7]=[CH:8][CH2:9][C@H:10]1[C:11](=[O:12])[CH2:13]2'

We should return that string and template_id 1914385.

Check if any need to map again? The mapped_rxn already has atom mapping. So final answer.
